inputs.text: A Wisconsin jury convicted Harry Wait of election fraud and identity theft after he requested ballots for Assembly Speaker Robin Vos and Racine Mayor Cory Mason without their consent. Wait said he was trying to expose vulnerabilities in voter registration, but leading a group that spreads false election claims makes this look less like responsible oversight than a stunt that can undermine trust in voting. The deeper lesson is that election systems need strong safeguards—and that political actors should not be allowed to turn claims of fraud into a weapon against voters’ confidence in democracy.
